## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

* As a potential customer I want to toggle between monthly and annual pricing So that I can choose my preferred billing cycle and see potential savings
* Acceptance Criteria:

    * Toggle switch between monthly and annual pricing
    * Show percentage/amount saved with annual billing
    * Update all pricing cards simultaneously when switching
    * Maintain selected billing preference during session
    * The whole component is clickable
    
* A storybook-story has been created, rendering the design from figma

longDescription:
## Purpose

The BillingCycleSwitch component enables users to easily compare monthly versus annual pricing options. By showing potential savings with annual billing, it helps drive conversions to longer-term subscriptions while giving users full control over their billing preference.

## Use Cases

- Toggle the entire pricing page between monthly and annual billing views
- Display strikethrough prices on cards when annual billing shows discounts
- Persist user's billing preference in localStorage so it remains selected during navigation
- Communicate savings visually to encourage annual subscription commitments

## Design Rationale

A well-designed price comparison toggle helps sell users on annual subscriptions by clearly showing the value proposition. The synchronized update of all pricing elements ensures consistency and reduces cognitive load. LocalStorage persistence improves user experience by remembering their preference across page reloads and navigation.
